adopted: Single canonical UI action registry in uiActionRegistry.ts executing all seven declared action kinds (navigate, openDrawer, selectEntity, setFilter, focusPanel, refreshCurrentView, runBffAction).
openDrawer dispatches to registered drawers (inspector, handoff, jobs, entityCreate, bulkResult, rollbackSaga, etc.) or returns explicit unsupported for unknown drawers.
focusPanel resolves registered panels and DOM element targets (id, data-panel, data-panel-id, data-testid) with smooth scrolling and focus, or returns explicit unsupported for missing panels.

runBffAction strictly requires confirmation and routes through HighRiskConfirm, executing through governed bffWrites.runAction facade with command receipt readback and idempotency protection; never performs direct mutation.
Action correlation key generated deterministically from turn and action payload, persisting execution status across sessions/reloads and preventing double execution on replay.
removed: Stub unsupported returns for openDrawer, focusPanel, and unconfirmed runBffAction placeholders.
not_changed: Backend mutation API contracts, read-only kernel behavior, HighRiskConfirm modal internals, and existing application routing.

acceptance_proof.all_seven_action_kinds_wired: All seven declared UI action kinds either dispatch to their respective registries or return explicit typed reasons on invalid parameters or unknown targets.
acceptance_proof.confirmation_and_readback: runBffAction triggers HighRiskConfirm and records the command receipt description (audit id, status, corr, idem) upon confirmation.
acceptance_proof.replay_prevention: Action correlation keys prevent duplicate execution when an action has already been completed.
acceptance_proof.single_registry: Evidence confirms a unified UI action registry and single dispatch path with no parallel unconfirmed write mechanisms.
